segments.normalizedSource: ```swift private func createRAWDiskImage() { let diskFd = open(diskImageURL.path, O_RDWR | O_CREAT, S_IRUSR | S_IWUSR) if diskFd == -1 { fatalError("Cannot create disk image.") } // 128 GB disk space. var result = ftruncate(diskFd, 128 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024) if result != 0 { fatalError("ftruncate() failed.") } result = close(diskFd) if result != 0 { fatalError("Failed to close the disk image.") } } ```
